visual.general_description: Eight-panel kidney biopsy microscopy composite for two cases.
visual.detailed_description: Four columns and two rows contain A/B/E/F on the upper row and C/D/G/H below. A-D are colored bright-field tissue images, E/F green fluorescence on black, and G/H grayscale ultrastructural views. F is split into two adjacent images. White panel labels are visible; no printed numerical scale or image date appears.

panels.detailed_description: An oblique strip of purple/pink tissue on a pale background contains many round/tubular profiles and multiple darker rounded tufts. White A labels the upper left. No scale bar or numeric magnification is printed.
